items.title: 8.3兆美元的市場發出警訊 「川普牛市」恐正如履薄冰
items.title_en: $8.3 Trillion Market Warning: The “Trump Bull Market” May Be on Thin Ice
paras: 儘管川普在社群上發文，他透過股票及其他資產，已經為美國賺進「數千億美元」，但他指揮的美股牛市背後，一個高達8.3兆美元的歷史級警訊正在悄悄浮現，顯示華爾街的多頭市場可能已如履薄冰。

市場對川普投顧信心現裂痕

回顧歷史，川普在第一任期內，道瓊、標普500和那斯達克指數分別大幅上漲57%、70%及142%。而在第二任期內，截至2026年9月2日，三大指數也再度揚升22%、28%與34%。
儘管帳面耀眼，但投資人的實際行動卻顯得格外謹慎。財經專欄作家Sean Williams指出，即使美國聯準會(Fed)在2024年9月至2025年12月期間連續降息6次，導致固定收益證券的殖利率下滑，傳統上應該會促使資金回流股市，但事實卻完全相反。

貨幣市場基金規模創紀錄

根據聯準會最新數據，第一季持有在「貨幣市場基金」中的總金融資產，已持續升至8.29兆美元的歷史新高。自2022年中期以來，此類資產規模已暴漲了65%。
Williams分析，貨幣市場基金主要投資於極安全的短期國庫券及定期存單(CD)，旨在保障本金並賺取穩定利息。在降息引導殖利率下降的情況下，資金仍瘋狂湧入此避險工具，反映出市場對「川普牛市」的高度懷疑，這批龐大資金並未如預期般回流股市。

估值過高、AI泡沫與融資餘額的三重隱憂

Williams點出三大紅線，解釋了為何投資人寧可抱著貨幣基金，也不願投入股市：
第一，美股估值過高：美股在2026年初迎來了近156年歷史上的「第二高」昂貴估值，歷史經驗顯示超高估值在長期內是難以持續的。
第二，AI泡沫化的疑慮：此輪牛市由AI革命催生，但Williams提醒，過去半世紀以來，每項變革性科技在初期都經歷過早期泡沫破裂階段，貨幣基金資產暴增正是防範AI泡沫破滅的布局。
第三，創紀錄的融資餘額：融資餘額(Outstanding Margin Debt)已創下歷史新高，進一步加劇了市場下行的風險。

歷史警訊：資金湧入多為股市崩盤前兆

過去50多年的歷史表明，貨幣基金資產的大幅攀升，往往是經濟衰退與股市崩盤的前兆。
Williams強調，在2008年金融海嘯以及2020年新冠疫情崩盤前夕，市場都曾出現過類似的資金瘋狂避險現象。這份高達8.3兆美元的警戒信號，正提醒投資人必須為隨時可能到來的逆風做好防範準備。
paras_en: Despite Trump’s social‑media posts and the billions of dollars he has allegedly earned for the United States through stocks and other assets, a historic $8.3 trillion warning signal is quietly emerging behind the bull market he commands, suggesting that Wall Street’s rally may be on thin ice.

Market confidence in Trump‑led investment advice is cracking. Historically, during Trump’s first term the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq rose 57%, 70% and 142% respectively. In his second term, as of September 2, 2026 the three major indices have again climbed 22%, 28% and 34%.

Even though the headline numbers look dazzling, investors’ actual behavior is unusually cautious. Financial columnist Sean Williams notes that even though the Federal Reserve cut rates six times between September 2024 and December 2025, lowering bond yields – which traditionally would push money back into equities – the opposite has happened.
Money‑market‑fund assets hit a record. According to the latest Fed data, total financial assets held in money‑market funds rose to a historic $8.29 trillion in Q1, up 65% since mid‑2022.

Williams explains that money‑market funds mainly invest in ultra‑safe short‑term Treasury bills and certificates of deposit to preserve principal and earn steady interest. Even as rate cuts drive yields down, money has poured into these safe‑haven vehicles, reflecting deep skepticism about the “Trump bull market” and showing that the massive cash has not returned to stocks as expected.
Three red‑flags: overvaluation, an AI bubble and record margin debt. Williams points to three major concerns that explain why investors prefer money‑market funds over equities:

First, U.S. equities are overvalued. At the start of 2026 the market reached the second‑highest valuation in the past 156 years, and history shows such extreme levels are unsustainable over the long term.

Second, worries about an AI bubble. This rally is driven by the AI revolution, but Williams warns that every transformative technology in the past half‑century has gone through an early‑stage bubble burst, and the surge in money‑market assets is a hedge against a potential AI bust.
Third, record‑high outstanding margin debt, which further amplifies downside risk for the market.

Historical warning: inflows into money‑market funds often precede market crashes. Over the past five decades, sharp rises in money‑market assets have frequently signaled upcoming recessions and equity market collapses.

Williams stresses that similar frantic safe‑haven flows occurred before the 2008 financial crisis and the 2020 COVID‑19 market crash. The $8.3 trillion warning signal is a reminder that investors must brace for possible headwinds at any time.

items.title: 美國「K型經濟」現反轉訊號？低所得家庭8月薪資成長罕見超越高所得
items.title_en: Is the U.S. “K-shaped Economy” Reversing? Low‑Income Households’ August Wage Growth Rarely Surpasses High‑Income
paras: 根據美國銀行最新的消費者存款帳戶數據，長期以來高所得與低所得家庭之間失衡的「K型」薪資成長狀況，可能正面臨轉變。
數據顯示，低所得家庭上個月的薪資年增率達到 4.7%，明顯高於高所得家庭的 3.5%。此一薪資差距縮小的趨勢，是在整體勞動力市場輕微降溫的背景下發生的，整體就業人數年增率從 7 月的 1.8% 降至約 1.5%。
美銀資深經濟學家David Michael Tinsley在報告中指出，高低所得家庭在稅後薪資成長上的長期「K型」走勢已經發生逆轉。雖然這波反轉是否能長期持續，仍面臨不確定性，但低所得勞工似乎正在逐步收復失地。
Tinsley分析，這波逆襲的部分原因，可歸功於《單一美好法案》(OBBBA)實施後扣繳稅額降低所帶來的稅後薪資提升，但低薪勞工市場本身的強勁表現更扮演了重要角色。
數據顯示，7 月份的換職率明顯高於 2025 年(但略低於 2022 年的大離職潮)，其中又以每周領薪的時薪人員換職率年增幅最大。由於換職通常會迎來加薪，這成為上個月縮減各所得族群薪資成長差距的主因。
此趨勢也引發政府高層關注。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)上個月接受 CNBC 專訪時，便明確宣告「K型經濟已經結束」。他指出，當前經濟更呈現出「C型經濟」的特徵，代表底層的薪資收入者終於在經濟體系中追回失地、逐步奪回劣勢。
paras_en: According to the latest consumer deposit account data from Bank of America, the long‑standing “K‑shaped” wage growth imbalance between high‑ and low‑income households in the United States may be shifting.

The data show that low‑income families saw an annual wage growth rate of 4.7% last month, clearly above the 3.5% recorded for high‑income families. This narrowing wage gap is occurring against a backdrop of a modest cooling in the overall labor market, with total employment’s annual growth rate falling from 1.8% in July to about 1.5%.

Bank of America senior economist David Michael Tinsley noted in the report that the long‑term “K‑shaped” trajectory of after‑tax wage growth for high‑ and low‑income households has reversed. While the durability of this reversal remains uncertain, low‑income workers appear to be gradually regaining ground.

Tinsley explained that part of this comeback can be attributed to higher after‑tax pay resulting from reduced withholding under the One‑Bill‑Better‑America Act (OBBBA), but the strong performance of the low‑wage labor market itself also plays a key role.

The figures reveal that July’s job‑switching rate was markedly higher than in 2025 (though slightly below the massive turnover seen in 2022), with hourly workers paid weekly showing the largest year‑over‑year increase in switching. Because job changes often bring pay raises, this was the main driver behind the reduced wage‑growth gap between income groups last month.

The trend has drawn attention from senior government officials. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC last month that the “K‑shaped economy is over.” He said the current economy now shows “C‑shaped” characteristics, indicating that lower‑wage earners are finally reclaiming lost ground and gradually overcoming their disadvantage.

items.title: 終於忍不住炫耀？川普社群狂發貼文與AI操盤圖 宣稱為美賺進數千億
items.title_en: Finally Can't Resist Boasting? Trump’s Social Media Flood of AI-Generated Charts Claims He Earned Tens of Billions for the U.S.
paras: 美國總統川普周日(6日)展開了一場長達 10 多個小時的社群媒體「洗版」行動。他在其創立的Truth Social平台上發布了至少 37 篇貼文，內容充斥著大量的AI生成圖像。他還配文指出，自己已經為美國在股票及其他資產上賺取了數千億美元。
在這些貼文中，最引人注目的是一張川普在白宮橢圓形辦公室內「親自操盤」的 AI 圖像。圖像中的川普盯著四個螢幕，畫面上顯示晶片大廠英特爾(INTC-US)的股價從 20 美元飆升至 95 美元。
川普在圖中配文寫道：「我是為了國家而做，而非自己。我已經為美國在股票及其他資產上賺取了數千億美元，但我得到的卻只有激進左派『蠢貨』民主黨人的批評。非常不公平，但又能怎麼辦呢！」
然而，這張以英特爾為主角的圖像隨即引發了道德爭議。根據政府倫理辦公室(OGE)的申報資料，川普的個人投資帳戶在 2026 年第一季便進行了超過 3,600 次股票交易，總價值逾 1 億美元，其中就包含數度買進英特爾股票。與此同時，美國政府本身也持有英特爾 10% 的股權。
儘管白宮強調這些交易皆由投資機構獨立管理，川普並未直接干涉，但川普在 2025 年個人賺取至少 22 億美元的財務申報曝光後，反對者質疑他正利用總統職權牟利。
面對這類質疑，川普在受訪時反駁表示，他的個人財富皆是由金融顧問投資，他根本不與他們交談。川普強調：「這應該就是所謂的『盲目帳戶』(blind account)……我之所以獲利，是因為股市在上漲，大家都在獲利。」
不過，蓋洛普(Gallup)上周發布的民調顯示，已有高達 90% 的美國民眾認為美國政府和政治領袖存在腐敗問題，這也讓川普的發言備受檢視。
此外，川普「真實社群」推出的「真實 API」(Truth API)服務也面臨調查。該服務每月收取 10 萬美元，能讓訂閱者提早獲取可能影響金融市場的政策宣布資訊。對此，美國參議員已敦促證券交易委員會(SEC)調查此舉是否違反聯邦證券法。
川普媒體臨時執行長麥格恩(Kevin McGurn)對此回應，這項服務純粹是「市場向我們提出的需求」。
除了股市議題，川普當天的洗版貼文還涉及了極具爭議的國際政局與領土宣稱。他發布了多張美伊戰爭的 AI 生成圖，包含伊朗哈爾克島(Kharg Island)爆炸、戰艦起火等畫面；川普甚至分享了將新墨西哥州改名為「新美國」、宣布「月球是我們的」，以及將美加邊境的安大略湖改名為「美國湖」的圖像。
對此，加拿大總理馬克·卡尼(Mark Carney)已公開回絕，表示加拿大「將會繼續稱其為安大略湖」。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump launched a marathon "spam" campaign on social media on Sunday (the 6th), posting at least 37 messages on his Truth Social platform over more than ten hours, many of which were filled with AI‑generated images. He added that he has earned the United States tens of billions of dollars in stocks and other assets.

The most eye‑catching post was an AI picture showing Trump "personally trading" inside the Oval Office. In the image Trump stares at four screens, one of which displays Intel Corp. (INTC‑US) stock soaring from $20 to $95.

Trump captioned the picture, "I do this for the country, not for myself. I’ve earned the United States tens of billions of dollars in stocks and other assets, but all I get is criticism from radical left‑wing ‘idiot’ Democrats. It’s very unfair, but what can you do about it?!"

The Intel‑focused image quickly sparked an ethics debate. According to filings from the Office of Government Ethics (OGE), Trump’s personal investment account made more than 3,600 stock trades worth over $100 million in the first quarter of 2026, including several purchases of Intel shares. At the same time, the U.S. government itself holds a 10% stake in Intel.

Although the White House stressed that the trades were handled independently by investment firms and Trump did not intervene directly, opponents pointed to his 2025 financial disclosure showing he personally earned at least $2.2 billion and accused him of leveraging the presidency for profit.

When questioned, Trump argued in an interview that his personal wealth is managed by financial advisors and that he never talks to them. He emphasized, "This is what they call a ‘blind account’… I made money because the market went up and everyone profited."
Nevertheless, a Gallup poll released last week showed that as many as 90% of Americans believe the government and political leaders are corrupt, putting Trump’s statements under intense scrutiny.

In addition, Trump’s Truth Social has rolled out a “Truth API” service that is under investigation. The service charges $100,000 per month to give subscribers early access to policy announcements that could move financial markets. U.S. senators have urged the SEC to examine whether the service violates federal securities laws.
Kevin McGurn, the interim CEO of Trump Media, responded that the service simply meets a “market demand” that was presented to them.

Beyond the stock‑market theme, Trump’s flood of posts that day also touched on highly controversial international politics and territorial claims. He shared multiple AI‑generated images of a U.S.–Iran war, including explosions on Iran’s Kharg Island and burning warships, and even posted pictures renaming New Mexico to “New America,” declaring “the Moon is ours,” and renaming Ontario Lake on the U.S.–Canada border to “America Lake.”
In response, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney publicly rejected the idea, stating Canada “will continue to call it Ontario Lake.”

items.title: 22周淨流入中止！全球股市淨流出55.9億美元 台股遭外資賣超22.2億美元亞股最慘
items.title_en: 22 Weeks of Net Inflows Halted! Global Stock Markets See $5.59 B Net Outflow, Taiwan Shares Lose $2.227 B to Foreign Sellers, Asian Markets Worst Performer
paras: 中東戰事重燃推高國際油價並加劇通膨疑慮，加上美國8月非農就業數據強勁強化市場對聯準會的升息預期，拖累全球風險資產表現。根據彭博統計，過去1周全球股票型ETF遭資金淨流出55.9億美元，正式終結先前連續22周淨流入態勢。其中美股及亞股成為資金撤出重災區，台股更遭外資賣超22.27億美元，居亞股之冠。
從市場區分，美股ETF單周淨流出高達85.73億美元，亞洲市場亦遭77.34億美元淨流出，其中中國市場流出11.25億美元；相對地，日本與歐洲市場則逆勢獲得9.98億美元及4.36億美元淨流入。在產業方面，保健、主題型與能源獲資金青睞，間接不動產、原物料與工業則面臨較大賣壓。
外資在亞洲股市操作同步偏空，受戰事與升息預期牽動，台股與南韓股市分別遭賣超22.27億美元與18.4億美元，成為外資提款主要對象。相較之下，避險資金則大幅湧入債券市場，單周固定收益型ETF獲169.84億美元淨流入，光是美國債市就吸引111.11億美元，顯示市場資金轉趨保守。
富蘭克林投顧表示，儘管近期資金出現波動，全球景氣與企業獲利基本面仍具韌性，但隨美債殖利率上行，建議股市配置可留意循環、價值與小型股題材，並搭配平衡型基金及黃金資產，藉此分散投資組合風險並捕捉輪動契機。
paras_en: The resurgence of conflict in the Middle East has pushed up international oil prices and heightened inflation concerns, while strong U.S. August non‑farm payroll data has reinforced market expectations of further Fed rate hikes, dragging down global risk‑asset performance. Bloomberg data shows that in the past week global equity ETFs suffered a net outflow of $5.59 billion, ending a 22‑week streak of net inflows. U.S. and Asian equities were the hardest hit, with Taiwan’s market seeing the biggest foreign‑seller outflow of $2.227 billion, the largest among Asian stocks.

In market‑by‑market terms, U.S. equity ETFs posted a weekly net outflow of $8.573 billion, while Asian markets saw a net outflow of $7.734 billion, including a $1.125 billion withdrawal from China. By contrast, Japan and Europe attracted net inflows of $998 million and $436 million respectively. Sector‑wise, healthcare, thematic and energy funds received inflows, whereas indirect real estate, raw materials and industrials faced heavier selling pressure.

Foreign investors turned uniformly bearish across Asian equities, driven by the war and rate‑hike expectations. Taiwan and South Korea saw foreign‑seller outflows of $2.227 billion and $1.84 billion respectively, making them the primary targets of capital withdrawals. In contrast, safe‑haven money rushed into bonds, with fixed‑income ETFs recording a net inflow of $16.984 billion for the week, of which U.S. Treasuries alone attracted $11.111 billion, indicating a shift toward more conservative positioning.

Franklin Templeton Investment Advisors noted that despite recent capital volatility, the global economy and corporate earnings fundamentals remain resilient. With U.S. Treasury yields rising, they recommend focusing equity allocations on cyclical, value and small‑cap themes, complemented by balanced funds and gold assets to diversify portfolio risk and capture rotation opportunities.

items.title: 研調：第二季DRAM產業營收季增59.5% 供應擴張持續落後需求成長
items.title_en: Research: Q2 DRAM Industry Revenue Up 59.5% YoY, Supply Expansion Still Lagging Behind Demand Growth
paras: 研究機構TrendForce最新發布的記憶體產業報告顯示，受惠於傳統DRAM合約價格強勢上漲，2026年第二季全球DRAM產業總營收，較上一季飆升59.5%，達到近1,547.3億美元。
此波營收暴增的核心驅動力，並非來自「賣出更多晶片」，而是源於供給緊繃下所帶動的價格調漲。
TrendForce指出，AI伺服器對大型語言模型(LLM)訓練與推理的需求，持續拉動高頻寬記憶體(HBM3e)、LPDDR5X與高容量RDIMM的出貨。這在無形中排擠了消費性DRAM的產能，進而使得消費性DRAM合約價出現強勁漲幅。
在供應方面，供應商庫存仍處於歷史低位，新增供應主要用於伺服器用途。因此，第二季 DRAM 位元出貨量僅略有成長。
在三大記憶體巨頭的表現方面，三星電子表現最為亮眼，因率先推進HBM4的量產與出貨，加上平均銷售單價(ASP)大漲，其單季DRAM營收季增63.4%至609.8億美元，以39.4%的市占率穩坐龍頭寶座。
相較之下，SK海力士(SKHY-US)雖位居第二，但因其位元出貨中HBM占比最高，受限於長期合約的價格彈性，其平均銷售單價漲幅較為受限，單季營收季增37.9%至385.9億美元，市占率下滑至24.9%。美光(MU-US)則因產能限制，將產品組合集中於高單價的伺服器DRAM，營收季增65.5%至360億美元，市占率略升至23.3%。
三大巨頭加速向先進製程轉移，也為專注於成熟製程的台灣廠商帶來了意外的溢出效應。在DDR4與DDR3合約價大漲的推動下，南亞科技(2408-TW)營收季增68.3%至26.12億美元；華邦電子(2344-TW)營收季增75.8%至9.98億美元；力積電(6770-TW)的DRAM營收也飆升167.8%至1.15億美元。
展望後市，TrendForce預期第三季常規DRAM合約價季增率將收縮至13%至18%，這反映出個人電腦(PC)與智慧型手機客戶對進一步漲價的承受力有限，部分需求已開始向低容量產品轉移。
paras_en: The research firm TrendForce’s latest memory‑industry report shows that, boosted by a strong rise in traditional DRAM contract prices, global DRAM industry revenue in Q2 2026 surged 59.5% from the previous quarter to nearly $154.73 billion.
The core driver of this revenue explosion is not selling more chips, but price hikes caused by tight supply conditions.

TrendForce notes that AI servers’ demand for large‑language‑model (LLM) training and inference continues to drive shipments of high‑bandwidth memory (HBM3e), LPDDR5X and high‑capacity RDIMMs, which in turn crowd out consumer‑grade DRAM capacity and push consumer DRAM contract prices sharply higher.
On the supply side, vendor inventories remain at historic lows and new supply is mainly earmarked for server use, so Q2 DRAM bit shipments only grew modestly.

Among the three memory giants, Samsung Electronics stood out, leading the way with early mass production and shipment of HBM4 and a large jump in average selling price (ASP), delivering a 63.4% quarterly DRAM revenue increase to $60.98 billion and cementing its 39.4% market‑share leadership.

By contrast, SK Hynix (SKHY‑US) ranked second but, because HBM accounts for the largest share of its bit shipments and long‑term contracts limit price flexibility, its ASP growth was more constrained, resulting in a 37.9% quarterly revenue rise to $38.59 billion and a market‑share drop to 24.9%; Micron (MU‑US), constrained by capacity, focused its product mix on high‑price server DRAM, posting a 65.5% revenue jump to $36.0 billion and a slight market‑share rise to 23.3%.

The three giants’ accelerated shift to advanced processes also created an unexpected spill‑over effect for Taiwan’s mature‑process manufacturers. Driven by the sharp rise in DDR4 and DDR3 contract prices, Nanya Technology (2408‑TW) saw quarterly revenue grow 68.3% to $2.612 billion, Winbond Electronics (2344‑TW) rose 75.8% to $998 million, and Powerchip Semiconductor (6770‑TW) saw its DRAM revenue surge 167.8% to $115 million.

Looking ahead, TrendForce expects the quarterly growth rate of regular DRAM contract prices in Q3 to narrow to 13%‑18%, reflecting limited price‑elasticity among PC and smartphone customers and a shift of some demand toward lower‑capacity products.

items.title_en: Guangyu August Revenue Hits 32‑Month High, Q4 to Push AI Server and Robot Product Shipments
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)旗下連接線束廣宇(2328-TW)今(7)日公告8月營收21.66 億元，創32個月薪高，月增5.68%、年增19.67%；廣宇表示，第四季將積極落實 AI 伺服器與機器人相關產品的出貨規劃，提升營收表現。
廣宇表示，8月在舊客戶拉貨動能持續增長及新業務出貨增加的貢獻，營收維持成長的趨勢去年同期，且去年同期客戶受美國關稅影響、出貨減少，因此基期較低，年對年有較大的成長

廣宇表示，面對近期市場挑戰，公司將積極爭取 AI 伺服器產品訂單，以期提振營收，同時仍將以優化獲利水準為主要發展策略目標，持續切入現有客戶的高端產品線，積極提升高毛利產品類別的比重。
此外，也將積極佈局人形機器人市場，憑藉線材與線束的經驗與實力，跨足人形機器人關鍵零組件領域，創建營收與獲利的新成長引擎。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) subsidiary cable harness maker Guangyu (2328‑TW) announced today that August revenue reached NT$2.166 billion, a 32‑month peak, up 5.68% month‑over‑month and 19.67% year‑over‑year. Guangyu said it will actively implement its shipment plan for AI servers and robot‑related products in the fourth quarter to boost revenue performance.

Guangyu said the August growth was driven by continued pull‑through from existing customers and increased shipments from new business, keeping revenue on an upward trend compared with the same period last year. Because customers were affected by U.S. tariffs and shipped less in the prior year, the base was lower, resulting in a larger year‑over‑year increase.

Cumulative revenue for the first eight months of the year was NT$13.845 billion, down 7.84% year‑over‑year. Guangyu noted that although the scale of shipments to existing customers was smaller than last year, the cumulative revenue still showed a year‑over‑year decline, but the contraction is gradually narrowing.

Facing recent market challenges, Guangyu said it will vigorously pursue AI server orders to lift revenue, while continuing to focus on optimizing profit margins as its main development strategy. The company aims to deepen penetration into high‑end product lines of existing customers and increase the proportion of high‑margin product categories.

In addition, Guangyu will actively position itself in the humanoid robot market, leveraging its cable and harness expertise to enter the key component segment for humanoid robots, creating a new engine for revenue and profit growth.

items.title: 鴻騰深化AI光互連布局 亮相深圳CIOE 2026
items.title_en: FIT Deepens AI Optical Interconnect Portfolio, Showcases at Shenzhen CIOE 2026
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)旗下鴻騰精密(FIT)(6088-HK)宣布將於 9 月 9 至 11 日參加深圳 2026 CIOE 光電博覽會，展出涵蓋 1.6T 高速光模組、ELSFP 外部雷射光源模組及 XPO 高密度連接方案的產品布局，掌握 AI 資料中心升級商機。
鴻騰表示，因應 AI 網路對高頻寬密度與高效散熱的需求，持續布局整合高密度連接與搭配液冷與矽光設計的 XPO 技術，並將展示用於 AI 伺服器機櫃的 224G NPO（近封裝光學）Socket 方案，拓展更貼近運算晶片的光電連接應用，展現從高速光模組邁向光、電、熱整合的發展方向。
鴻騰積極布局光通訊關鍵元件與整合方案，透過深化產業合作、提早對接下一代系統需求，擴大在 AI 供應鏈中的參與範圍。延續此策略，鴻騰預計於 9 月 16 日在台北舉辦「2026 鴻騰科技日」，以「Light at Scale: The Next Frontier in Data Center Interconnects」為主題，透過四場專題演講及產業論壇，探討 AI 光互連的技術方向與商業化機會。
專題演講邀請 Lumentum Dr. Wupen Yuen、NTT Innovative Devices Yoshiaki Sato、前Coherent CEO，現任Avalanche Thinking Dr. Chuck Mattera，以及 ams OSRAM Ashkan Seyedi 四位業界領袖分享。
論壇由鴻騰光通訊顧問劉一誠博士主持，邀集來自Semtech, Hisense, Macom 專家，以及鴻海研究院半導體研究所所長郭浩中博士，共同交流下一代光通訊的部署挑戰與產業機會。
paras_en: FIT (6088-HK), a subsidiary of Hon Hai (2317-TW), announced it will attend the Shenzhen 2026 CIOE Optoelectronics Expo from September 9 to 11, displaying a product lineup that includes 1.6‑Tb/s high‑speed optical modules, ELSFP external laser source modules and XPO high‑density connectivity solutions, positioning itself to capture AI data‑center upgrade opportunities.

FIT said that to meet AI networks’ demand for high‑bandwidth density and efficient cooling, it continues to develop XPO technology that integrates high‑density connections with liquid‑cooling and silicon‑photonic designs, and will showcase a 224‑Gb/s NPO (Near‑Package Optics) socket solution for AI server racks, extending optical‑electrical connectivity closer to compute chips and illustrating a development path from high‑speed optical modules toward integrated optics, electronics and thermal management.

FIT is actively building key optical‑communication components and integrated solutions, deepening industry collaborations and early engagement with next‑generation system requirements to broaden its role in the AI supply chain. Continuing this strategy, FIT plans to hold a “2026 FIT Technology Day” in Taipei on September 16, themed “Light at Scale: The Next Frontier in Data Center Interconnects,” featuring four keynote talks and an industry forum to discuss the technical direction and commercialization prospects of AI optical interconnects.

The keynote speakers include industry leaders Lumentum’s Dr. Wupen Yuen, NTT Innovative Devices’ Yoshiaki Sato, former Coherent CEO and current Avalanche Thinking’s Dr. Chuck Mattera, and ams OSRAM’s Ashkan Seyedi, who will share their insights.

The forum will be moderated by Dr. Liu Yicheng, FIT’s optical communications advisor, and will gather experts from Semtech, Hisense, MACOM, as well as Dr. Guo Hao‑zhong, director of the Semiconductor Research Institute at Hon Hai Research Institute, to discuss deployment challenges and industry opportunities for next‑generation optical communications.

items.title: 4支科技股進入標普100指數 Nike遭剔除 18年輝煌紀錄告終
items.title_en: Four Tech Stocks Enter S&P 100 Index as Nike Is Removed, Ending an 18-Year Streak
paras: 標普道瓊指數公司宣布，全球運動鞋巨頭 Nike(NKE-US) 將於 9 月 21 日美股開盤前被正式剔除出標普 100 指數，結束其將近 18 年的輝煌紀錄。儘管 Nike 仍將保留在更廣泛的標普 500 指數中，但這項重大調整，也象徵著其市場主導地位已面臨根本性的動搖。
在此次季度調整中，高露潔(CL-US)、Simon 地產集團(SPG-US)和Honeywell航太(HONA-US)也將退出標普 100 指數，空缺則由戴爾(DELL-US)、Palo Alto Networks (PANW-US)、Arista Networks (ANET-US) 及 SanDisk (SNDK-US)等4家科技與 AI 基礎設施公司接替，反映出指數向科技業傾斜的趨勢。
Nike 股價在 9 月 4 日跌至 38.40 美元，創下近 12 年來新低，相較於 2021 年底的紀錄高點已慘跌約 78% 至 79%。這場長達5年的衰退，使其市值慘重蒸發超過 2,200 億美元，目前市值僅剩約 570 億美元。其 2026 財年營收為 464 億美元，表現近乎停滯，而被寄予厚望的 Nike Direct 直營業務與數位營收則分別下滑 6% 與 12%。
分析指出，Nike 的困境在於其過度激進的直營(DTC)戰略。此舉削減了與批發通路(如 Foot Locker 等)的合作夥伴關係，大幅減少與新消費者的觸點。同時，Nike 產品創新力不足，過度依賴經典鞋款(如 Air Force 1、AJ1)的換色重刻，加上通路為清庫存而進行折扣戰，嚴重蠶食了品牌的溢價空間。
在關鍵的大中華市場，Nike 2026 財年營收按本幣計算重挫 11% 至 13%，除了安踏、李寧等中國本土品牌崛起搶占份額外，On 和 Hoka 等新興高性能跑鞋品牌也正在全球快速蠶食其份額。
儘管現任執行長 Elliott Hill 承諾推動全面改革，著手重建零售商關係並控制庫存，但市場分析師認為其營收復甦及創新成效仍顯緩慢。
paras_en: S&P Dow Jones Indices announced that global sneaker giant Nike (NKE-US) will be formally removed from the S&P 100 index before the market opens on September 21, ending its nearly 18‑year run. Nike will remain in the broader S&P 500, but the move signals a fundamental shake‑up of its market dominance.

In this quarterly reshuffle, Colgate (CL-US), Simon Property Group (SPG-US) and Honeywell Aerospace (HONA-US) will also exit the S&P 100, making way for four technology and AI‑infrastructure firms – Dell (DELL-US), Palo Alto Networks (PANW-US), Arista Networks (ANET-US) and SanDisk (SNDK-US) – reflecting the index’s tilt toward tech.

Nike’s share price fell to $38.40 on September 4, a 12‑year low, roughly a 78‑79% drop from its record high at the end of 2021. The five‑year decline has erased more than $220 billion of market value, leaving a market cap of about $57 billion. Fiscal 2026 revenue was $46.4 billion, essentially flat, while the much‑hyped Nike Direct business and digital sales fell 6% and 12% respectively.

Analysts say Nike’s woes stem from an overly aggressive direct‑to‑consumer (DTC) strategy that has strained relationships with wholesale partners such as Foot Locker, cutting off many consumer touchpoints. In addition, product innovation has lagged, with the brand leaning heavily on color‑way refreshes of classics like the Air Force 1 and AJ1, while discounting to clear inventory has eroded its pricing power.

In the crucial Greater China market, Nike’s fiscal 2026 revenue in local currency fell 11%‑13% as domestic rivals Anta and Li‑Ning gained share and emerging performance‑running brands such as On and Hoka rapidly ate into its market globally.

Although current CEO Elliott Hill has pledged a sweeping reform, rebuilding retailer relationships and tightening inventory, market analysts say revenue recovery and innovation progress remain sluggish.

items.title: 8.3兆美元的市場發出警訊 「川普牛市」恐正如履薄冰
items.title_en: $8.3 Trillion Market Warning: The “Trump Bull Market” May Be on Thin Ice
paras: 儘管川普在社群上發文，他透過股票及其他資產，已經為美國賺進「數千億美元」，但他指揮的美股牛市背後，一個高達8.3兆美元的歷史級警訊正在悄悄浮現，顯示華爾街的多頭市場可能已如履薄冰。

市場對川普投顧信心現裂痕

回顧歷史，川普在第一任期內，道瓊、標普500和那斯達克指數分別大幅上漲57%、70%及142%。而在第二任期內，截至2026年9月2日，三大指數也再度揚升22%、28%與34%。
儘管帳面耀眼，但投資人的實際行動卻顯得格外謹慎。財經專欄作家Sean Williams指出，即使美國聯準會(Fed)在2024年9月至2025年12月期間連續降息6次，導致固定收益證券的殖利率下滑，傳統上應該會促使資金回流股市，但事實卻完全相反。

貨幣市場基金規模創紀錄

根據聯準會最新數據，第一季持有在「貨幣市場基金」中的總金融資產，已持續升至8.29兆美元的歷史新高。自2022年中期以來，此類資產規模已暴漲了65%。
Williams分析，貨幣市場基金主要投資於極安全的短期國庫券及定期存單(CD)，旨在保障本金並賺取穩定利息。在降息引導殖利率下降的情況下，資金仍瘋狂湧入此避險工具，反映出市場對「川普牛市」的高度懷疑，這批龐大資金並未如預期般回流股市。

估值過高、AI泡沫與融資餘額的三重隱憂

Williams點出三大紅線，解釋了為何投資人寧可抱著貨幣基金，也不願投入股市：
第一，美股估值過高：美股在2026年初迎來了近156年歷史上的「第二高」昂貴估值，歷史經驗顯示超高估值在長期內是難以持續的。
第二，AI泡沫化的疑慮：此輪牛市由AI革命催生，但Williams提醒，過去半世紀以來，每項變革性科技在初期都經歷過早期泡沫破裂階段，貨幣基金資產暴增正是防範AI泡沫破滅的布局。
第三，創紀錄的融資餘額：融資餘額(Outstanding Margin Debt)已創下歷史新高，進一步加劇了市場下行的風險。

歷史警訊：資金湧入多為股市崩盤前兆

過去50多年的歷史表明，貨幣基金資產的大幅攀升，往往是經濟衰退與股市崩盤的前兆。
Williams強調，在2008年金融海嘯以及2020年新冠疫情崩盤前夕，市場都曾出現過類似的資金瘋狂避險現象。這份高達8.3兆美元的警戒信號，正提醒投資人必須為隨時可能到來的逆風做好防範準備。
paras_en: Despite Trump’s social‑media posts and the billions of dollars he has allegedly earned for the United States through stocks and other assets, a historic $8.3 trillion warning signal is quietly emerging behind the bull market he commands, suggesting that Wall Street’s rally may be on thin ice.

Market confidence in Trump‑led investment advice is cracking. Historically, during Trump’s first term the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq rose 57%, 70% and 142% respectively. In his second term, as of September 2, 2026 the three major indices have again climbed 22%, 28% and 34%.

Even though the headline numbers look dazzling, investors’ actual behavior is unusually cautious. Financial columnist Sean Williams notes that even though the Federal Reserve cut rates six times between September 2024 and December 2025, lowering bond yields – which traditionally would push money back into equities – the opposite has happened.
Money‑market‑fund assets hit a record. According to the latest Fed data, total financial assets held in money‑market funds rose to a historic $8.29 trillion in Q1, up 65% since mid‑2022.

Williams explains that money‑market funds mainly invest in ultra‑safe short‑term Treasury bills and certificates of deposit to preserve principal and earn steady interest. Even as rate cuts drive yields down, money has poured into these safe‑haven vehicles, reflecting deep skepticism about the “Trump bull market” and showing that the massive cash has not returned to stocks as expected.
Three red‑flags: overvaluation, an AI bubble and record margin debt. Williams points to three major concerns that explain why investors prefer money‑market funds over equities:

First, U.S. equities are overvalued. At the start of 2026 the market reached the second‑highest valuation in the past 156 years, and history shows such extreme levels are unsustainable over the long term.

Second, worries about an AI bubble. This rally is driven by the AI revolution, but Williams warns that every transformative technology in the past half‑century has gone through an early‑stage bubble burst, and the surge in money‑market assets is a hedge against a potential AI bust.
Third, record‑high outstanding margin debt, which further amplifies downside risk for the market.

Historical warning: inflows into money‑market funds often precede market crashes. Over the past five decades, sharp rises in money‑market assets have frequently signaled upcoming recessions and equity market collapses.

Williams stresses that similar frantic safe‑haven flows occurred before the 2008 financial crisis and the 2020 COVID‑19 market crash. The $8.3 trillion warning signal is a reminder that investors must brace for possible headwinds at any time.

items.title: 美國「K型經濟」現反轉訊號？低所得家庭8月薪資成長罕見超越高所得
items.title_en: Is the U.S. “K-shaped Economy” Reversing? Low‑Income Households’ August Wage Growth Rarely Surpasses High‑Income
paras: 根據美國銀行最新的消費者存款帳戶數據，長期以來高所得與低所得家庭之間失衡的「K型」薪資成長狀況，可能正面臨轉變。
數據顯示，低所得家庭上個月的薪資年增率達到 4.7%，明顯高於高所得家庭的 3.5%。此一薪資差距縮小的趨勢，是在整體勞動力市場輕微降溫的背景下發生的，整體就業人數年增率從 7 月的 1.8% 降至約 1.5%。
美銀資深經濟學家David Michael Tinsley在報告中指出，高低所得家庭在稅後薪資成長上的長期「K型」走勢已經發生逆轉。雖然這波反轉是否能長期持續，仍面臨不確定性，但低所得勞工似乎正在逐步收復失地。
Tinsley分析，這波逆襲的部分原因，可歸功於《單一美好法案》(OBBBA)實施後扣繳稅額降低所帶來的稅後薪資提升，但低薪勞工市場本身的強勁表現更扮演了重要角色。
數據顯示，7 月份的換職率明顯高於 2025 年(但略低於 2022 年的大離職潮)，其中又以每周領薪的時薪人員換職率年增幅最大。由於換職通常會迎來加薪，這成為上個月縮減各所得族群薪資成長差距的主因。
此趨勢也引發政府高層關注。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)上個月接受 CNBC 專訪時，便明確宣告「K型經濟已經結束」。他指出，當前經濟更呈現出「C型經濟」的特徵，代表底層的薪資收入者終於在經濟體系中追回失地、逐步奪回劣勢。
paras_en: According to the latest consumer deposit account data from Bank of America, the long‑standing “K‑shaped” wage growth imbalance between high‑ and low‑income households in the United States may be shifting.

The data show that low‑income families saw an annual wage growth rate of 4.7% last month, clearly above the 3.5% recorded for high‑income families. This narrowing wage gap is occurring against a backdrop of a modest cooling in the overall labor market, with total employment’s annual growth rate falling from 1.8% in July to about 1.5%.

Bank of America senior economist David Michael Tinsley noted in the report that the long‑term “K‑shaped” trajectory of after‑tax wage growth for high‑ and low‑income households has reversed. While the durability of this reversal remains uncertain, low‑income workers appear to be gradually regaining ground.

Tinsley explained that part of this comeback can be attributed to higher after‑tax pay resulting from reduced withholding under the One‑Bill‑Better‑America Act (OBBBA), but the strong performance of the low‑wage labor market itself also plays a key role.

The figures reveal that July’s job‑switching rate was markedly higher than in 2025 (though slightly below the massive turnover seen in 2022), with hourly workers paid weekly showing the largest year‑over‑year increase in switching. Because job changes often bring pay raises, this was the main driver behind the reduced wage‑growth gap between income groups last month.

The trend has drawn attention from senior government officials. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC last month that the “K‑shaped economy is over.” He said the current economy now shows “C‑shaped” characteristics, indicating that lower‑wage earners are finally reclaiming lost ground and gradually overcoming their disadvantage.

items.title: 終於忍不住炫耀？川普社群狂發貼文與AI操盤圖 宣稱為美賺進數千億
items.title_en: Finally Can't Resist Boasting? Trump’s Social Media Flood of AI-Generated Charts Claims He Earned Tens of Billions for the U.S.
paras: 美國總統川普周日(6日)展開了一場長達 10 多個小時的社群媒體「洗版」行動。他在其創立的Truth Social平台上發布了至少 37 篇貼文，內容充斥著大量的AI生成圖像。他還配文指出，自己已經為美國在股票及其他資產上賺取了數千億美元。
在這些貼文中，最引人注目的是一張川普在白宮橢圓形辦公室內「親自操盤」的 AI 圖像。圖像中的川普盯著四個螢幕，畫面上顯示晶片大廠英特爾(INTC-US)的股價從 20 美元飆升至 95 美元。
川普在圖中配文寫道：「我是為了國家而做，而非自己。我已經為美國在股票及其他資產上賺取了數千億美元，但我得到的卻只有激進左派『蠢貨』民主黨人的批評。非常不公平，但又能怎麼辦呢！」
然而，這張以英特爾為主角的圖像隨即引發了道德爭議。根據政府倫理辦公室(OGE)的申報資料，川普的個人投資帳戶在 2026 年第一季便進行了超過 3,600 次股票交易，總價值逾 1 億美元，其中就包含數度買進英特爾股票。與此同時，美國政府本身也持有英特爾 10% 的股權。
儘管白宮強調這些交易皆由投資機構獨立管理，川普並未直接干涉，但川普在 2025 年個人賺取至少 22 億美元的財務申報曝光後，反對者質疑他正利用總統職權牟利。
面對這類質疑，川普在受訪時反駁表示，他的個人財富皆是由金融顧問投資，他根本不與他們交談。川普強調：「這應該就是所謂的『盲目帳戶』(blind account)……我之所以獲利，是因為股市在上漲，大家都在獲利。」
不過，蓋洛普(Gallup)上周發布的民調顯示，已有高達 90% 的美國民眾認為美國政府和政治領袖存在腐敗問題，這也讓川普的發言備受檢視。
此外，川普「真實社群」推出的「真實 API」(Truth API)服務也面臨調查。該服務每月收取 10 萬美元，能讓訂閱者提早獲取可能影響金融市場的政策宣布資訊。對此，美國參議員已敦促證券交易委員會(SEC)調查此舉是否違反聯邦證券法。
川普媒體臨時執行長麥格恩(Kevin McGurn)對此回應，這項服務純粹是「市場向我們提出的需求」。
除了股市議題，川普當天的洗版貼文還涉及了極具爭議的國際政局與領土宣稱。他發布了多張美伊戰爭的 AI 生成圖，包含伊朗哈爾克島(Kharg Island)爆炸、戰艦起火等畫面；川普甚至分享了將新墨西哥州改名為「新美國」、宣布「月球是我們的」，以及將美加邊境的安大略湖改名為「美國湖」的圖像。
對此，加拿大總理馬克·卡尼(Mark Carney)已公開回絕，表示加拿大「將會繼續稱其為安大略湖」。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump launched a marathon "spam" campaign on social media on Sunday (the 6th), posting at least 37 messages on his Truth Social platform over more than ten hours, many of which were filled with AI‑generated images. He added that he has earned the United States tens of billions of dollars in stocks and other assets.

The most eye‑catching post was an AI picture showing Trump "personally trading" inside the Oval Office. In the image Trump stares at four screens, one of which displays Intel Corp. (INTC‑US) stock soaring from $20 to $95.

Trump captioned the picture, "I do this for the country, not for myself. I’ve earned the United States tens of billions of dollars in stocks and other assets, but all I get is criticism from radical left‑wing ‘idiot’ Democrats. It’s very unfair, but what can you do about it?!"

The Intel‑focused image quickly sparked an ethics debate. According to filings from the Office of Government Ethics (OGE), Trump’s personal investment account made more than 3,600 stock trades worth over $100 million in the first quarter of 2026, including several purchases of Intel shares. At the same time, the U.S. government itself holds a 10% stake in Intel.

Although the White House stressed that the trades were handled independently by investment firms and Trump did not intervene directly, opponents pointed to his 2025 financial disclosure showing he personally earned at least $2.2 billion and accused him of leveraging the presidency for profit.

When questioned, Trump argued in an interview that his personal wealth is managed by financial advisors and that he never talks to them. He emphasized, "This is what they call a ‘blind account’… I made money because the market went up and everyone profited."
Nevertheless, a Gallup poll released last week showed that as many as 90% of Americans believe the government and political leaders are corrupt, putting Trump’s statements under intense scrutiny.

In addition, Trump’s Truth Social has rolled out a “Truth API” service that is under investigation. The service charges $100,000 per month to give subscribers early access to policy announcements that could move financial markets. U.S. senators have urged the SEC to examine whether the service violates federal securities laws.
Kevin McGurn, the interim CEO of Trump Media, responded that the service simply meets a “market demand” that was presented to them.

Beyond the stock‑market theme, Trump’s flood of posts that day also touched on highly controversial international politics and territorial claims. He shared multiple AI‑generated images of a U.S.–Iran war, including explosions on Iran’s Kharg Island and burning warships, and even posted pictures renaming New Mexico to “New America,” declaring “the Moon is ours,” and renaming Ontario Lake on the U.S.–Canada border to “America Lake.”
In response, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney publicly rejected the idea, stating Canada “will continue to call it Ontario Lake.”

items.title: OpenAI Astra是加速走向失控的「算力怪獸」？能自己操作電腦、思維鏈恐越來越難讀懂
items.title_en: Is OpenAI's Astra a Powering‑Up "Computing Monster" on the Verge of Losing Control? Can It Operate Computers and Think Chains Become Harder to Read?
paras: OpenAI推出新一代旗艦模型GPT-6 Astra，主打讓AI直接操作電腦、執行複雜任務，被公司視為邁向「AGI時代」的重要一步；然而，Astra採用的新架構也引發AI安全疑慮，專家警告，當模型推理過程逐漸難以被人類讀懂，未來AI監控可能面臨更大挑戰。
根據《財富》報導，OpenAI在9月3日發布Astra，其中一項代表性功能為「電腦使用」（Computer Use），讓AI能像人類一樣操作電腦。
OpenAI展示的影片中，使用者透過語音下達指令，AI則完成電腦操作，整體互動過程相對流暢。
OpenAI共同創辦人暨總裁Greg Brockman表示，電腦使用能力是Astra眾多新功能中相當重要的一項，模型可以高速處理試算表、填寫表單及瀏覽網頁。
除了電腦操作外，OpenAI也強調Astra在數學運算、軟體工程與網路安全防禦方面的能力。公司公布的基準測試結果顯示，Astra在多項任務上的表現優於GPT-5.6 Sol及Anthropic的Claude Fable 5.1。
在ARC-AGI-3測試中，Astra得分98.6%，GPT-5.6 Sol為7.8%，Claude Opus 5則為30%；該測試主要用於評估模型面對未見情境時的推理能力。在網路安全挑戰ExploitBench中，Astra則取得滿分，高於GPT-5.6 Sol的78.5%。
Brockman認為，電腦使用能力可能被視為「AGI時代」的開端。他指出，若有人認為目前已經進入AGI時代，這種看法並非毫無道理；甚至將Astra視為第一個AGI，也有其合理性。
不過，AGI的定義至今仍存在爭議。OpenAI過去曾將AGI定義為，能在所有具經濟價值的工作中達到或超越人類水準的自動化系統。
Brockman則表示，AGI並非突然出現，而是逐步累積形成。

Astra初期限縮開放　網路安全能力受到管制

儘管Astra具備直接操作電腦的能力，但OpenAI並未立即全面開放所有功能。公司初期僅向部分企業客戶提供Astra，包括專注網路安全的Daybreak計畫客戶，並計畫在數日內向Plus、Pro及Enterprise用戶開放，同時透過OpenAI API及AWS提供。
OpenAI表示，提供給相關客戶的版本不具備高階網路安全任務能力。
OpenAI發言人指出，Astra屬於規模非常大的模型，初期限制使用範圍，主要是為了逐步擴充計算能力。
OpenAI研究副總裁Aidan Clark則表示，Astra開發涉及公司迄今最大規模的訓練，首次在德州Stargate資料中心使用超過10萬顆GPU進行預訓練。
Astra的推出也與網路安全事件有關。OpenAI在7月Hugging Face遭AI代理入侵事件後延後Astra發布，以增加額外安全措施。此後，公司強化監控並進一步隔離訓練環境，但外界仍質疑新增監控措施是否足夠。
依照美國AI安全框架相關條款，OpenAI在發布Astra前也將模型提交美國政府審查。不過，該框架屬於科技業與川普政府之間的自願性協議，具體內容尚未公開，也不是正式的公開審查程序。
Astra同時成為OpenAI首個達到「關鍵網路安全能力門檻」的模型。這項門檻來自OpenAI內部「準備框架」，公司將依模型可能帶來的風險採取不同安全措施。
OpenAI表示，在適當條件下，Astra能夠在沒有人工監督的情況下發現並利用過去未知的安全漏洞，因此最先進的網路安全能力目前僅向部分合作夥伴開放。

Astra新架構引發疑慮　AI思維鏈恐更難監控

相較於Astra能直接操作電腦所帶來的能力提升，AI安全專家更關注其模型架構可能造成的另一項影響：人類未來是否還能看懂AI究竟是如何進行推理。
Astra部分採用了「循環深度」或「循環Transformer」技術。這種架構可以減少模型處理指令所需的計算資源，提高AI運算效率。
但另一方面，循環式處理也可能讓模型的思維鏈，也就是推理步驟，不再完全以自然語言呈現，使人類難以監控其行為及動機。
這對AI安全而言尤其重要。現階段，思維鏈監控被視為觀察AI代理是否產生意外或未經授權行為的重要方法之一。若模型的推理過程逐漸變得難以閱讀，人類監控其行為與意圖的難度也可能隨之提高。
OpenAI首席科學家Jakub Pachocki表示，公司對思維鏈監控高度重視，自早期推理模型推出以來，OpenAI便持續投入相關研究。他也透露，公司對循環Transformer的使用有所限制，以維持推理過程的可讀性。
Pachocki承認，未來思維鏈監控可能面臨更大的挑戰，但他認為這不一定源自模型架構本身，OpenAI仍可採取措施強化監控，相關工作也是目前研究重點之一。
不過，AI安全領域仍出現反對聲音。
曾任OpenAI安全研究員、現任Guidelight AI Standards負責人的Stephen Adler認為，OpenAI此舉可能踩到AI產業少數重要的安全紅線。
華盛頓特區智庫AI政策網路政策總監Peter Wildford也警告，OpenAI採用循環深度技術可能帶來令人擔憂的後果。
Wildford指出，在7月Hugging Face遭AI代理入侵事件中，OpenAI及外部AI評估公司能夠透過包括讀取模型思維鏈在內的方法，重建部分事件經過。如果未來AI的思維鏈變得更加難以理解，人類可能因此失去重要的監控手段。
前OpenAI治理研究員Daniel Kokotajlo則警告，即使OpenAI未進一步採用讓思維鏈更難理解的架構，其他AI公司仍可能跟進。
他因此呼籲Pachocki推動制定業界通用的思維鏈可監控性標準，避免AI模型推理過程的透明度持續下降。
paras_en: OpenAI has launched a new flagship model, GPT‑6 Astra, marketed as enabling AI to directly operate computers and perform complex tasks, a step the company sees as crucial toward the "AGI era"; however, the new architecture also raises AI safety concerns, with experts warning that as the model’s reasoning process becomes increasingly opaque, future AI monitoring may face greater challenges.
According to a report by Fortune, OpenAI released Astra on September 3, with one representative feature being "Computer Use," allowing the AI to operate a computer like a human.
In the demonstration video, a user issues voice commands and the AI completes computer operations, with the overall interaction process being relatively smooth.

OpenAI co‑founder and president Greg Brockman said that the computer‑use capability is a particularly important feature among Astra’s many new functions, and that the model can process spreadsheets, fill out forms and browse the web at high speed.

In addition to computer operation, OpenAI highlighted Astra’s abilities in mathematics, software engineering and network‑security defense. Benchmark results released by the company show that Astra outperforms GPT‑5.6 Sol and Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5.1 on several tasks.

In the ARC‑AGI‑3 test, Astra scored 98.6%, GPT‑5.6 Sol 7.8% and Claude Opus 5 30%; the test mainly evaluates a model’s reasoning ability in unseen scenarios. In the network‑security challenge ExploitBench, Astra achieved a perfect score, higher than GPT‑5.6 Sol’s 78.5%.

Brockman believes that the computer‑use capability could be seen as the beginning of the "AGI era." He pointed out that if some people think we are already in the AGI era, that view is not without merit; even treating Astra as the first AGI has some rationality.
However, the definition of AGI remains controversial. OpenAI has previously defined AGI as an automated system that can achieve or surpass human performance in all economically valuable work.
Brockman said that AGI does not appear suddenly, but accumulates gradually.

Astra’s initial release was limited, and its network‑security capabilities are regulated. Although Astra can directly operate computers, OpenAI did not immediately open all features. The company initially offered Astra only to a subset of enterprise customers, including those in the Daybreak network‑security program, and plans to open it to Plus, Pro and Enterprise users in a few days, as well as through the OpenAI API and AWS.
OpenAI said that the version provided to relevant customers does not have advanced network‑security task capabilities.
A spokesperson for OpenAI noted that Astra is a very large model, and its early use is limited mainly to gradually expand computing power.

OpenAI research vice president Aidan Clark said that Astra’s development involved the company’s largest training effort to date, using more than 100,000 GPUs at the Stargate data center in Texas for pre‑training.

Astra’s launch is also related to network‑security incidents. After the July Hugging Face AI‑agent intrusion incident, OpenAI delayed Astra’s release to add extra security measures. The company then strengthened monitoring and further isolated the training environment, but outsiders still question whether the added monitoring is sufficient.

According to U.S. AI safety framework provisions, OpenAI also submitted the model to U.S. government review before releasing Astra. However, the framework is a voluntary agreement between the tech industry and the Trump administration, its details are not public, and it is not a formal public review process.

Astra also became OpenAI’s first model to reach the "critical network‑security capability threshold." This threshold comes from OpenAI’s internal "preparation framework," and the company will take different safety measures based on the risks the model may pose.

OpenAI said that under appropriate conditions, Astra can discover and exploit previously unknown security vulnerabilities without human supervision, so the most advanced network‑security capabilities are currently only available to select partners.

Astra’s new architecture raises concerns that AI thinking chains may become harder to monitor. Compared to the capability of directly operating computers, AI safety experts are more concerned about another potential impact of the model’s architecture: whether humans will still be able to understand how AI actually reasons in the future.

Astra partially uses "recurrent depth" or "recurrent Transformer" technology. This architecture can reduce the computational resources required to process commands, improving AI computational efficiency.

On the other hand, recurrent processing may also cause the model’s thinking chain, i.e., reasoning steps, to no longer be fully presented in natural language, making it harder for humans to monitor its behavior and motives.

This is especially important for AI safety. At present, monitoring the thinking chain is considered one of the key methods for observing whether an AI agent produces unintended or unauthorized behavior. If the model’s reasoning process becomes increasingly unreadable, the difficulty for humans to monitor its behavior and intent may also increase.

OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki said the company places high importance on thinking‑chain monitoring, and has continued to invest in related research since the early reasoning model launch. He also revealed that the company has imposed some restrictions on the use of recurrent Transformers to maintain the readability of the reasoning process.

Pachocki acknowledged that future thinking‑chain monitoring may face greater challenges, but he believes this does not necessarily stem from the model architecture itself; OpenAI can still take measures to strengthen monitoring, and this work is also a current research focus.
However, there are still opposing voices in the AI safety field.
Stephen Adler, former OpenAI safety researcher and current head of Guidelight AI Standards, believes that OpenAI’s move may have stepped on a few important safety red lines in the AI industry.
Peter Wildford, director of AI policy at the Washington, D.C. think‑tank AI Policy Network, also warned that OpenAI’s use of recurrent depth technology could lead to concerning consequences.

Wildford pointed out that in the July Hugging Face AI‑agent intrusion incident, OpenAI and external AI assessment companies were able to reconstruct part of the incident by reading the model’s thinking chain. If AI’s thinking chain becomes harder to understand in the future, humans may lose an important monitoring tool.

Former OpenAI governance researcher Daniel Kokotajlo warned that even if OpenAI does not further adopt architectures that make the thinking chain harder to understand, other AI companies may still follow suit.
He therefore called on Pachocki to push for industry‑wide standards for monitoring the thinking chain, to prevent the transparency of AI model reasoning processes from continually declining.

items.title: 美債多空迎關鍵一周 兩大事件恐讓長短債同步劇烈波動
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Bonds Face a Pivotal Week; Two Events Could Trigger Simultaneous Sharp Moves in Short‑ and Long‑Term Yields
paras: 美債投資人正為各期限債券可能出現更劇烈震盪預作準備，本周兩項潛在催化因素，可能同時牽動短天期與長天期美債大幅波動。
美國勞動節長周末結束後，歷經政府債市已相當動盪的一周，交易員將聚焦本周兩項關鍵日程，希望藉此研判美國財政部長貝森特與聯準會（Fed）主席沃許的政策意向。
美國財政部預定周三(9日)公布債券買回細節，並於隔日執行。依據擴大後的計畫，買回規模至少將是原定上限的兩倍，市場甚至認為可能擴大至3至5倍。周五(11日)則將公布最新通膨數據，華許與其他Fed官員已暗示，這項數據將是決定本月是否升息的關鍵。
這兩項事件可能使假期縮短的本周行情更為震盪。投資人仍須應對左右美國利率市場的兩股力量：通常主導短期殖利率的貨幣政策，以及著眼於壓低長期借貸成本的財政政策。
就業數據推升升息預期
美國8月就業成長優於預期後，上周五美債殖利率曲線趨平，短期殖利率走高，長天期債券則大致持穩。交易員因而提高對Fed本月升息的押注，但財政部與Fed政策前景仍不明朗，限制市場波動幅度。
加拿大帝國商業銀行私人財富管理固定收益主管Tim Musial表示，就業報告只是「前菜」，9月11日公布的通膨數據才是「主菜」。他也指出，財政部債券買回有別於經濟成長與通膨等基本面因素，是難以預測的挑戰，「在這種環境下，或許應該稍微降低風險」。
買回規模牽動長債行情
財政部擴大債券買回計畫的消息出乎投資人意料，因為公告時間並不在例行季度融資聲明期間。此前，30年期美債殖利率一度升至2007年以來最高水準，截至上周五仍徘徊在約5.25%的高檔。
財政部表示，買回規模將較先前的20億美元「至少增加一倍」，讓貝森特保留政策調整空間。若實際買回金額超過40億美元，可能帶動美債上漲。
通膨數據成Fed決策關鍵
另一方面，沃許上月在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會發表演說時表示，Fed目前的首要重點應放在物價。彭博調查的經濟學家預估，美國8月消費者物價指數（CPI）將年增3.4%，剔除波動較大的食品與能源後，核心CPI預估年增2.4%。
根據交換市場定價，截至上周五，投資人認為Fed本月升息1碼的機率約為60%。Fed下一次利率決策將於9月16日公布。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury investors are preparing for potentially sharper volatility across bonds of all maturities, as two possible catalysts this week could simultaneously drive large swings in both short‑term and long‑term U.S. Treasuries.

After the Labor Day long weekend, traders will focus on two key dates this week following an already turbulent week in the government bond market, hoping to gauge the policy intentions of Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen and Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell.

The Treasury plans to announce details of a bond buyback on Wednesday (the 9th) and execute it the next day. Under the expanded plan, the buyback size will be at least twice the original cap, with some market participants believing it could be three to five times larger. On Friday (the 11th) the latest inflation data will be released, and Powell and other Fed officials have hinted that this figure will be decisive for whether rates are raised this month.

These two events could make an already compressed trading week even more volatile. Investors will still have to contend with the two forces that drive the U.S. rate market: monetary policy, which typically dominates short‑term yields, and fiscal policy, which aims to keep long‑term borrowing costs low.
Employment data lifts rate‑hike expectations

After August’s employment growth outperformed expectations, the Treasury yield curve flattened last Friday, with short‑term yields rising while long‑term bonds held relatively steady. Traders therefore increased their bets on a Fed rate hike this month, but the outlook for Treasury and Fed policy remains unclear, limiting the magnitude of market moves.

Tim Musial, head of fixed‑income for private wealth at CIBC, said the jobs report was just an "appetizer" and that the inflation data due on September 11 would be the "main course." He also noted that the Treasury’s bond buyback is unrelated to fundamentals such as economic growth and inflation and poses an unpredictable challenge, adding that "in this environment, it may be prudent to dial back risk a bit."
Buyback size influences long‑bond dynamics

The news that the Treasury is expanding its bond buyback program surprised investors because the announcement came outside the regular quarterly financing statements. Earlier, the 30‑year Treasury yield had risen to its highest level since 2007, hovering around 5.25% as of last Friday.

The Treasury said the buyback would be "at least double" the previous $20 billion, giving Secretary Yellen room to adjust policy. If the actual repurchase amount exceeds $40 billion, it could push Treasury prices higher.
Inflation data is key to Fed decisions

Separately, Powell said at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting last month that the Fed’s top priority should be price stability. Bloomberg‑surveyed economists project that U.S. CPI for August will rise 3.4% year‑over‑year, with core CPI—excluding the more volatile food and energy components—expected to increase 2.4% annually.

Based on swap‑market pricing as of last Friday, investors assign roughly a 60% probability that the Fed will raise rates by one quarter‑point this month. The Fed’s next rate decision is scheduled for September 16.

items.title: 美股周一因勞動節休市
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Closed Monday for Labor Day
paras: 美國股市周一(7日)因勞動節假期休市一天，紐約證券交易所(NYSE)與那斯達克(Nasdaq)均不開盤，美股常規交易全面暫停，期權交易市場也同步關閉，預計將於周二上午 9:30 恢復正常交易。
此外，美國債券市場(包括國債、房貸擔保證券、高收益企業債、市政債及部分貨幣市場)以及場外交易(OTC)市場全數關閉，同樣將在周二重啟。鄰國加拿大的多倫多證券交易所當天也因勞動節休市一日。
市場分析指出，由於美股與美債兩大市場缺席，全球市場的整體流動性在今日將顯著變薄，這在北美交易時段會更加明顯。因此，分析師提醒，在周二市場恢復深度流動性之前，投資人對於美元、黃金或股指期貨的任何顯著波動，都應保持審慎與警惕，避免盲目跟進。
歷史數據顯示，9月份對股市而言通常是個艱難的月份。雖然今年上半年人工智慧(AI)熱潮推動了標普 500 指數走高，但隨著借貸成本上升，近幾周投資人承壓，市場回吐了部分漲幅。
不過，市場的平靜很快就會在周二重開盤後被打破，焦點將迅速轉向通膨與聯準會(Fed)利率政策的辯論。除了周四將公布 8 月生產者物價指數(PPI)外，周五公布的 8 月消費者物價指數CPI，更是市場最關注指標。這兩項數據在下周聯準會召開貨幣政策會議前，將承載極高的市場關注度。
paras_en: U.S. equity markets were closed on Monday (the 7th) for the Labor Day holiday, with both the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and Nasdaq not opening. All regular U.S. trading was halted, and the options market was also closed, with normal trading expected to resume at 9:30 a.m. on Tuesday.

In addition, the U.S. bond market – including Treasuries, mortgage‑backed securities, high‑yield corporate bonds, municipal bonds and certain money‑market instruments – as well as the over‑the‑counter (OTC) market were completely shut and will also reopen on Tuesday. Canada’s Toronto Stock Exchange was likewise closed for Labor Day.

Analysts note that the absence of both U.S. equities and U.S. bonds will markedly thin global liquidity today, especially during the North American trading session. They caution investors to remain prudent and vigilant about any significant moves in the dollar, gold or index futures until deep liquidity returns on Tuesday, and to avoid blind chasing.

Historical data show that September is typically a tough month for equities. Although the AI boom lifted the S&P 500 in the first half of the year, rising borrowing costs have pressured investors in recent weeks, prompting a partial unwind of gains.

However, the market’s calm is expected to end quickly after the Tuesday open, with focus shifting to inflation and Fed rate policy debates. In addition to the August Producer Price Index (PPI) due on Thursday, the August Consumer Price Index (CPI) released on Friday will be the most closely watched gauge, both carrying high market attention ahead of the Fed’s monetary policy meeting next week.

items.title: 九月效應碰上史上第二高估值 歷史將再重演？
items.title_en: September Effect Meets Historically Second‑Highest Valuation – Will History Repeat?
paras: 歷史上，九月一向是標普500指數表現最差的月份之一，甚至被稱為「九月效應」。然而，財經專欄作家Steven Porrello指出，今年的九月不僅籠罩在傳統的走弱陰影下，還適逢美股估值達到歷史第二高的時期，使市場不確定性大增。
他強調，今年的異常與真實的市場不確定性交織在一起。投資人擔憂的問題包括： 頑固通膨、能源價格上漲、央行鷹派信號、美國公債殖利率攀升、美加貿易戰、美伊之間的實際戰爭，以及對AI泡沫的擔憂。
雖然市場也有企業獲利飆升、經濟穩定成長，以及上漲動能逐漸擴散至超大型領頭羊以外等利多，但隱憂仍不容忽視。
Porrello表示，一項可靠的估值指標已拉響警報，即「席勒本益比(CAPE)」正處於歷史高位。這一指標平均了標普500指數過去10年經通膨調整後的盈餘，用以平滑景氣循環的波動。回顧過去155年的歷史，CAPE的平均值僅約18，歷史最高紀錄是網路泡沫時期的44，而如今的數據卻已高達約41。
Porrello認為，高CAPE值雖不直接「導致」崩盤，卻反映出股價已被嚴重高估，更容易受到任何觸發因素而引發劇烈的拋售潮。
雖然目前的牛市有可能重演網路泡沫破滅的結局，但Porrello指出，歷史不會完全重演，許多優質企業仍將持續獲利。因此，他建議投資人切勿恐慌、過度反應或盲目預測市場高低點。
Porrello主張，此時最佳策略是繼續持有並投資於自己深信的優質公司，即便在面臨大跌與壞消息時堅守立場看似有些「愚蠢」，但歷史往往會回報願意忍受波動、著眼長線的投資人。
paras_en: Historically, September has been one of the worst months for the S&P 500, even dubbed the “September effect.” Yet financial columnist Steven Porrello notes that this September is not only shrouded in the usual weakness but also coincides with U.S. equity valuations at the second‑highest level ever, dramatically raising market uncertainty.

He stresses that this year’s abnormality is intertwined with genuine market uncertainty. Investors are worried about stubborn inflation, rising energy prices, hawkish central‑bank signals, climbing U.S. Treasury yields, the U.S.–Canada trade dispute, an actual war between the U.S. and Iran, and concerns over an AI bubble.
Although there are bullish factors such as soaring corporate earnings, steady economic growth, and momentum spreading beyond the mega‑cap leaders, the underlying worries cannot be ignored.

Porrello points out that a reliable valuation gauge has sounded the alarm: the Cyclically Adjusted Price‑Earnings ratio (CAPE) is at a historic high. This metric averages the S&P 500’s inflation‑adjusted earnings over the past ten years to smooth out business‑cycle fluctuations. Over the past 155 years, the CAPE’s average is about 18, its peak was 44 during the dot‑com bubble, and today it sits around 41.
Porrello believes that while a high CAPE does not directly cause a crash, it signals that stocks are severely overvalued and thus more vulnerable to any trigger that could spark a sharp sell‑off.

Although the current bull market could end up mirroring the dot‑com bust, Porrello notes history will not repeat exactly and many high‑quality companies will continue to generate profits. Therefore, he advises investors not to panic, overreact, or blindly try to time market highs and lows.

Porrello argues that the best strategy now is to keep holding and investing in companies you firmly believe in; even if staying the course during steep declines and bad news may seem “foolish,” history tends to reward those who endure volatility and focus on the long term.

items.title: 4支科技股進入標普100指數 Nike遭剔除 18年輝煌紀錄告終
items.title_en: Four Tech Stocks Enter S&P 100 Index as Nike Is Removed, Ending an 18-Year Streak
paras: 標普道瓊指數公司宣布，全球運動鞋巨頭 Nike(NKE-US) 將於 9 月 21 日美股開盤前被正式剔除出標普 100 指數，結束其將近 18 年的輝煌紀錄。儘管 Nike 仍將保留在更廣泛的標普 500 指數中，但這項重大調整，也象徵著其市場主導地位已面臨根本性的動搖。
在此次季度調整中，高露潔(CL-US)、Simon 地產集團(SPG-US)和Honeywell航太(HONA-US)也將退出標普 100 指數，空缺則由戴爾(DELL-US)、Palo Alto Networks (PANW-US)、Arista Networks (ANET-US) 及 SanDisk (SNDK-US)等4家科技與 AI 基礎設施公司接替，反映出指數向科技業傾斜的趨勢。
Nike 股價在 9 月 4 日跌至 38.40 美元，創下近 12 年來新低，相較於 2021 年底的紀錄高點已慘跌約 78% 至 79%。這場長達5年的衰退，使其市值慘重蒸發超過 2,200 億美元，目前市值僅剩約 570 億美元。其 2026 財年營收為 464 億美元，表現近乎停滯，而被寄予厚望的 Nike Direct 直營業務與數位營收則分別下滑 6% 與 12%。
分析指出，Nike 的困境在於其過度激進的直營(DTC)戰略。此舉削減了與批發通路(如 Foot Locker 等)的合作夥伴關係，大幅減少與新消費者的觸點。同時，Nike 產品創新力不足，過度依賴經典鞋款(如 Air Force 1、AJ1)的換色重刻，加上通路為清庫存而進行折扣戰，嚴重蠶食了品牌的溢價空間。
在關鍵的大中華市場，Nike 2026 財年營收按本幣計算重挫 11% 至 13%，除了安踏、李寧等中國本土品牌崛起搶占份額外，On 和 Hoka 等新興高性能跑鞋品牌也正在全球快速蠶食其份額。
儘管現任執行長 Elliott Hill 承諾推動全面改革，著手重建零售商關係並控制庫存，但市場分析師認為其營收復甦及創新成效仍顯緩慢。
paras_en: S&P Dow Jones Indices announced that global sneaker giant Nike (NKE-US) will be formally removed from the S&P 100 index before the market opens on September 21, ending its nearly 18‑year run. Nike will remain in the broader S&P 500, but the move signals a fundamental shake‑up of its market dominance.

In this quarterly reshuffle, Colgate (CL-US), Simon Property Group (SPG-US) and Honeywell Aerospace (HONA-US) will also exit the S&P 100, making way for four technology and AI‑infrastructure firms – Dell (DELL-US), Palo Alto Networks (PANW-US), Arista Networks (ANET-US) and SanDisk (SNDK-US) – reflecting the index’s tilt toward tech.

Nike’s share price fell to $38.40 on September 4, a 12‑year low, roughly a 78‑79% drop from its record high at the end of 2021. The five‑year decline has erased more than $220 billion of market value, leaving a market cap of about $57 billion. Fiscal 2026 revenue was $46.4 billion, essentially flat, while the much‑hyped Nike Direct business and digital sales fell 6% and 12% respectively.

Analysts say Nike’s woes stem from an overly aggressive direct‑to‑consumer (DTC) strategy that has strained relationships with wholesale partners such as Foot Locker, cutting off many consumer touchpoints. In addition, product innovation has lagged, with the brand leaning heavily on color‑way refreshes of classics like the Air Force 1 and AJ1, while discounting to clear inventory has eroded its pricing power.

In the crucial Greater China market, Nike’s fiscal 2026 revenue in local currency fell 11%‑13% as domestic rivals Anta and Li‑Ning gained share and emerging performance‑running brands such as On and Hoka rapidly ate into its market globally.

Although current CEO Elliott Hill has pledged a sweeping reform, rebuilding retailer relationships and tightening inventory, market analysts say revenue recovery and innovation progress remain sluggish.

items.title: 8.3兆美元的市場發出警訊 「川普牛市」恐正如履薄冰
items.title_en: $8.3 Trillion Market Warning: The “Trump Bull Market” May Be on Thin Ice
paras: 儘管川普在社群上發文，他透過股票及其他資產，已經為美國賺進「數千億美元」，但他指揮的美股牛市背後，一個高達8.3兆美元的歷史級警訊正在悄悄浮現，顯示華爾街的多頭市場可能已如履薄冰。

市場對川普投顧信心現裂痕

回顧歷史，川普在第一任期內，道瓊、標普500和那斯達克指數分別大幅上漲57%、70%及142%。而在第二任期內，截至2026年9月2日，三大指數也再度揚升22%、28%與34%。
儘管帳面耀眼，但投資人的實際行動卻顯得格外謹慎。財經專欄作家Sean Williams指出，即使美國聯準會(Fed)在2024年9月至2025年12月期間連續降息6次，導致固定收益證券的殖利率下滑，傳統上應該會促使資金回流股市，但事實卻完全相反。

貨幣市場基金規模創紀錄

根據聯準會最新數據，第一季持有在「貨幣市場基金」中的總金融資產，已持續升至8.29兆美元的歷史新高。自2022年中期以來，此類資產規模已暴漲了65%。
Williams分析，貨幣市場基金主要投資於極安全的短期國庫券及定期存單(CD)，旨在保障本金並賺取穩定利息。在降息引導殖利率下降的情況下，資金仍瘋狂湧入此避險工具，反映出市場對「川普牛市」的高度懷疑，這批龐大資金並未如預期般回流股市。

估值過高、AI泡沫與融資餘額的三重隱憂

Williams點出三大紅線，解釋了為何投資人寧可抱著貨幣基金，也不願投入股市：
第一，美股估值過高：美股在2026年初迎來了近156年歷史上的「第二高」昂貴估值，歷史經驗顯示超高估值在長期內是難以持續的。
第二，AI泡沫化的疑慮：此輪牛市由AI革命催生，但Williams提醒，過去半世紀以來，每項變革性科技在初期都經歷過早期泡沫破裂階段，貨幣基金資產暴增正是防範AI泡沫破滅的布局。
第三，創紀錄的融資餘額：融資餘額(Outstanding Margin Debt)已創下歷史新高，進一步加劇了市場下行的風險。

歷史警訊：資金湧入多為股市崩盤前兆

過去50多年的歷史表明，貨幣基金資產的大幅攀升，往往是經濟衰退與股市崩盤的前兆。
Williams強調，在2008年金融海嘯以及2020年新冠疫情崩盤前夕，市場都曾出現過類似的資金瘋狂避險現象。這份高達8.3兆美元的警戒信號，正提醒投資人必須為隨時可能到來的逆風做好防範準備。
paras_en: Despite Trump’s social‑media posts and the billions of dollars he has allegedly earned for the United States through stocks and other assets, a historic $8.3 trillion warning signal is quietly emerging behind the bull market he commands, suggesting that Wall Street’s rally may be on thin ice.

Market confidence in Trump‑led investment advice is cracking. Historically, during Trump’s first term the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq rose 57%, 70% and 142% respectively. In his second term, as of September 2, 2026 the three major indices have again climbed 22%, 28% and 34%.

Even though the headline numbers look dazzling, investors’ actual behavior is unusually cautious. Financial columnist Sean Williams notes that even though the Federal Reserve cut rates six times between September 2024 and December 2025, lowering bond yields – which traditionally would push money back into equities – the opposite has happened.
Money‑market‑fund assets hit a record. According to the latest Fed data, total financial assets held in money‑market funds rose to a historic $8.29 trillion in Q1, up 65% since mid‑2022.

Williams explains that money‑market funds mainly invest in ultra‑safe short‑term Treasury bills and certificates of deposit to preserve principal and earn steady interest. Even as rate cuts drive yields down, money has poured into these safe‑haven vehicles, reflecting deep skepticism about the “Trump bull market” and showing that the massive cash has not returned to stocks as expected.
Three red‑flags: overvaluation, an AI bubble and record margin debt. Williams points to three major concerns that explain why investors prefer money‑market funds over equities:

First, U.S. equities are overvalued. At the start of 2026 the market reached the second‑highest valuation in the past 156 years, and history shows such extreme levels are unsustainable over the long term.

Second, worries about an AI bubble. This rally is driven by the AI revolution, but Williams warns that every transformative technology in the past half‑century has gone through an early‑stage bubble burst, and the surge in money‑market assets is a hedge against a potential AI bust.
Third, record‑high outstanding margin debt, which further amplifies downside risk for the market.

Historical warning: inflows into money‑market funds often precede market crashes. Over the past five decades, sharp rises in money‑market assets have frequently signaled upcoming recessions and equity market collapses.

Williams stresses that similar frantic safe‑haven flows occurred before the 2008 financial crisis and the 2020 COVID‑19 market crash. The $8.3 trillion warning signal is a reminder that investors must brace for possible headwinds at any time.

items.title: 美國「K型經濟」現反轉訊號？低所得家庭8月薪資成長罕見超越高所得
items.title_en: Is the U.S. “K-shaped Economy” Reversing? Low‑Income Households’ August Wage Growth Rarely Surpasses High‑Income
paras: 根據美國銀行最新的消費者存款帳戶數據，長期以來高所得與低所得家庭之間失衡的「K型」薪資成長狀況，可能正面臨轉變。
數據顯示，低所得家庭上個月的薪資年增率達到 4.7%，明顯高於高所得家庭的 3.5%。此一薪資差距縮小的趨勢，是在整體勞動力市場輕微降溫的背景下發生的，整體就業人數年增率從 7 月的 1.8% 降至約 1.5%。
美銀資深經濟學家David Michael Tinsley在報告中指出，高低所得家庭在稅後薪資成長上的長期「K型」走勢已經發生逆轉。雖然這波反轉是否能長期持續，仍面臨不確定性，但低所得勞工似乎正在逐步收復失地。
Tinsley分析，這波逆襲的部分原因，可歸功於《單一美好法案》(OBBBA)實施後扣繳稅額降低所帶來的稅後薪資提升，但低薪勞工市場本身的強勁表現更扮演了重要角色。
數據顯示，7 月份的換職率明顯高於 2025 年(但略低於 2022 年的大離職潮)，其中又以每周領薪的時薪人員換職率年增幅最大。由於換職通常會迎來加薪，這成為上個月縮減各所得族群薪資成長差距的主因。
此趨勢也引發政府高層關注。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)上個月接受 CNBC 專訪時，便明確宣告「K型經濟已經結束」。他指出，當前經濟更呈現出「C型經濟」的特徵，代表底層的薪資收入者終於在經濟體系中追回失地、逐步奪回劣勢。
paras_en: According to the latest consumer deposit account data from Bank of America, the long‑standing “K‑shaped” wage growth imbalance between high‑ and low‑income households in the United States may be shifting.

The data show that low‑income families saw an annual wage growth rate of 4.7% last month, clearly above the 3.5% recorded for high‑income families. This narrowing wage gap is occurring against a backdrop of a modest cooling in the overall labor market, with total employment’s annual growth rate falling from 1.8% in July to about 1.5%.

Bank of America senior economist David Michael Tinsley noted in the report that the long‑term “K‑shaped” trajectory of after‑tax wage growth for high‑ and low‑income households has reversed. While the durability of this reversal remains uncertain, low‑income workers appear to be gradually regaining ground.

Tinsley explained that part of this comeback can be attributed to higher after‑tax pay resulting from reduced withholding under the One‑Bill‑Better‑America Act (OBBBA), but the strong performance of the low‑wage labor market itself also plays a key role.

The figures reveal that July’s job‑switching rate was markedly higher than in 2025 (though slightly below the massive turnover seen in 2022), with hourly workers paid weekly showing the largest year‑over‑year increase in switching. Because job changes often bring pay raises, this was the main driver behind the reduced wage‑growth gap between income groups last month.

The trend has drawn attention from senior government officials. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC last month that the “K‑shaped economy is over.” He said the current economy now shows “C‑shaped” characteristics, indicating that lower‑wage earners are finally reclaiming lost ground and gradually overcoming their disadvantage.

items.title: 升息預期+交易量萎縮 日元強升創下半年新高
items.title_en: Rate‑Hike Expectations and Shrinking Trading Volume Push Yen to Half‑Year High
paras: 日元兌美元匯率周一(7日)強漲，急升至半年多以來新高，領漲非美貨幣。
交易數據顯示，日元兌美元匯率周一一度擴大漲幅達 1.4%，最高升至 154.06，創下自 2026 年 2 月 23 日以來的最強紀錄，並成功衝破 155 這一關鍵防線。由於美國適逢勞動節假期休市，全球交易量顯著萎縮，清淡的市況進一步放大了匯率的波動，使得短線走勢更為劇烈。
推動此輪日元反彈的核心動力，在於市場對日本央行(BOJ)將採取更積極貨幣政策的強烈預期。 市場目前高度聚焦 9 月 18 日的日銀利率決策，積極押注日銀屆時將升息 25 個基點。日本央行審議委員高田創先前的發言更助長了升息情緒，他透露連續升息不無可能。
此外，日本政府年金投資基金(GPIF)可能調整資產配置的傳聞、月初實質資金的常態性重新配置，以及原油價格下跌改善日本貿易條件，皆為日元提供了關鍵支持。
技術面上，日元成功突破 155 心理關卡，被視為多空逆轉的重要信號。 投資機構 State Street 策略師 Loo 指出，155 關卡在過去官方干預時曾作為日元底部的「地板」，破位極具指標性。一旦匯價衝破該關卡，隨即觸發了下方龐大的止損單，迫使期權交易商拋售美元，進而加劇日元漲幅。
三菱日聯信託銀行外匯交易主管Motonari Sakai表示，若日元升破 154 低點，下一個目標恐將直指 152 日元區間。
與此同時，日本官方先前為了捍衛日元所付出的巨額代價也隨之曝光。日本財務省最新數據揭露，截至 8 月底，日本持有的外國證券頭寸創紀錄地暴跌了 878 億美元，直接用於資助近期干預。在截至 8 月 26 日的一整個月內，東京當局共砸下創紀錄的 15.4 兆日元(約合 98.6 億美元)支持本國貨幣。
儘管日元上周已升值 2.4%，日本最高外匯官員三村淳強調防守姿態並未改變。Russell Investments 策略主管 Van Luu 分析指出，此輪上漲更多是由市場「有機」驅動，顯得更有意義。
paras_en: The yen surged against the dollar on Monday (the 7th), jumping to a new high not seen in more than six months and leading the rally among non‑U.S. currencies.

Trading data showed the yen‑dollar pair briefly expanded its gain to 1.4% on Monday, peaking at 154.06 – the strongest level since February 23, 2026 – and successfully breaking the critical 155 barrier. Because the United States was closed for the Labor Day holiday, global trading volume contracted sharply, and the thin market amplified the exchange‑rate swings, making the short‑term move even more volatile.

The core driver of this yen rebound is the market’s strong expectation that the Bank of Japan (BOJ) will adopt a more aggressive monetary policy. Market participants are now focused on the BOJ’s rate decision on September 18 and are betting that the central bank will raise rates by 25 basis points. Comments earlier from BOJ policy‑maker Takata Sōsen, who said a series of hikes is not out of the question, further fueled the rate‑hike sentiment.

In addition, rumours that the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) may rebalance its asset allocation, routine re‑allocation of real funds at the start of the month, and lower oil prices improving Japan’s trade conditions have all provided key support for the yen.

On the technical side, the yen’s break above the 155 psychological level is seen as an important signal of a bullish reversal. State Street strategist Loo noted that the 155 mark has historically acted as a “floor” during official interventions, so a break is highly indicative. Once the price pierced that level, a large wave of stop‑loss orders below was triggered, forcing options dealers to sell dollars and further accelerating the yen’s rise.
Mitsubishi UFJ Trust Bank’s FX trading head Motonari Sakai said that if the yen clears the 154 low, the next target could be the 152‑yen range.

At the same time, the huge cost Japan has incurred to defend the yen has been disclosed. Ministry of Finance data show that by the end of August, Japan’s foreign‑securities holdings had plunged by a record $87.8 billion, directly used to fund recent interventions. Over the full month ending August 26, Tokyo authorities spent a record ¥15.4 trillion (about $9.86 billion) to support the domestic currency.

Although the yen appreciated 2.4% last week, Japan’s top foreign‑exchange official Jun Mimura stressed that the defensive stance has not changed. Russell Investments strategy head Van Luu argued that this rally is largely “organic” market‑driven, making it more meaningful.

items.title: 〈台幣〉偏強整理創近3個月高點 升值7.8分收31.552元
items.title_en: TWD Strengthens, Consolidates Near 3‑Month High, Gains 7.8 ¢ to 31.552
paras: 儘管目前市場預期美國聯準會9月升息機率過半，不過，隨著資金再度簇擁AI相關電子股，台股加權指數今(7)日強彈775點，新台幣早盤升貶互見，午盤過後越走越強，一度創6月中旬以來新高，終場收在31.552元，升值7.8分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值18.32億美元。
新台幣今日以31.61元、升值2分開出後，早盤升貶互見低見31.651元，但午盤過後偏強，最高來到31.505元，全日高低價差1.46角。
觀察主要亞幣全面走升，以日元飆升0.7%最多，其次為新台幣收升0.25%，韓元升0.2%左右，泰銖升逾0.1%，人民幣和星元小升0.05%上下，美元指數小貶0.1%左右。
國泰證期研究部指出，美國 8 月非農就業人口大增 16.2 萬人，遠高於市場預期的 5.6 萬人，且 7 月數據大幅上修至增加 2.1 萬人， 強韌的就業數據推升緊縮預期，CME FedWatch 顯示 9 月升息 1 碼機率跳升至約 60%。
而本周市場焦點轉向即將公布的美國 CPI和PPI 數據，通膨走勢將成為聯準會利率決策分水嶺，仍須留意市場對高利率恐維持更久的擔憂。
paras_en: Despite market expectations that the U.S. Federal Reserve has more than a 50% chance of raising rates in September, the Taiwan weighted index surged 775 points today (the 7th), as funds once again flocked to AI‑related semiconductor stocks. The New Taiwan dollar fluctuated in the early session but grew stronger after lunch, briefly hitting a new high not seen since mid‑June and closing at 31.552, a 7.8‑cent appreciation, with Taipei foreign‑exchange brokers handling $1.832 billion in turnover.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.61, up 2 cents, and slipped to a low of 31.651 in the early session, but after lunch it turned bullish, reaching a high of 31.505, with the day's high‑low spread at 1.46 ¢.

Major Asian currencies were broadly higher, led by the Japanese yen which jumped 0.7%. The New Taiwan dollar rose 0.25%, the Korean won about 0.2%, the Thai baht more than 0.1%, while the Chinese yuan and Singapore dollar each edged up roughly 0.05%; the U.S. dollar index fell about 0.1%.

Citi Securities Research noted that U.S. non‑farm payrolls surged by 162,000 in August, far exceeding the market’s 56,000 forecast, and July’s figure was sharply revised up by 21,000. The robust employment data lifted tightening expectations, and CME FedWatch shows the probability of a 25‑basis‑point rate hike in September jumping to roughly 60%.

This week’s market focus shifts to the upcoming U.S. CPI and PPI releases, as inflation trends will be a watershed for the Fed’s rate‑setting decisions, and investors remain wary of concerns that high rates may need to be maintained longer than expected.

items.title: 半導體強勁與外資湧入 韓元匯率衝上兩年高點
items.title_en: Strong Semiconductor Momentum and Foreign Inflows Push Won to Two-Year High
paras: 韓元兌美元匯率周一(7日)強升，匯率一度上漲1.3%，至1,334.70韓元，創下自2024年10月，接近兩年以來新高。
近期韓元的反彈力道極為強勁，相較於2026年7月的低點，韓元已大幅回升了約250韓元，今年以來的累計升幅則達到約6%。
本次韓元強勢上漲主要受到多重利多因素推動。其中，強勁的出口貿易奠定了堅實基礎。今年以來，南韓累計出口額已創下7,094億美元的歷史新高，提前外加超越2025年全年的紀錄。其中，受惠於人工智慧(AI)晶片需求引爆，1至8月半導體出口額大幅增長了169.6%。
其次，外資持續湧入股市提供關鍵動能，周一外資大舉買入超過8,000億韓元(約5.98億美元)的南韓Kospi指數成份股，這已是外資連續第三個交易日淨流入，並由三星電子與SK海力士等半導體巨頭領漲。
此外，出口商累積了大量外匯收益並延遲兌換，使南韓五大銀行的企業美元存款攀升至約770億美元的歷史新高。
儘管市場對聯準會9月升息的預期升至57%至60%之間，這可能為韓元帶來一定阻力，但外資對南韓資產的持續需求仍為匯率提供強大支撐。
不過，分析師也指出，未來的升值步伐可能會面臨挑戰。紐約梅隆銀行高級策略師 Geoffrey Yu 表示，隨著韓元漲勢顯得越發緊繃，可能會促使南韓國內資產管理機構解除部分海外資產的避險部位，或是推動南韓散戶重啟海外股票投資。
paras_en: The won‑dollar exchange rate surged sharply on Monday (the 7th), rising as much as 1.3% to 1,334.70 won, marking the highest level since October 2024 and a near two‑year peak.
The won’s recent rebound has been exceptionally strong; compared with its low in July 2026, it has recovered by roughly 250 won, and the cumulative gain this year is about 6%.

The current won rally is driven by multiple bullish factors. Robust export trade has laid a solid foundation, with South Korea’s cumulative exports this year reaching a record $709.4 billion, already surpassing the full‑year record for 2025. In particular, AI chip demand has spurred a 169.6% surge in semiconductor exports from January to August.

In addition, continued foreign inflows into the equity market have provided key momentum. On Monday, foreign investors bought more than 8 trillion won (about $598 million) of KOSPI constituent stocks, marking the third consecutive day of net foreign purchases, led by semiconductor giants Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.

Furthermore, exporters have accumulated large foreign‑exchange earnings and delayed conversion, pushing corporate dollar deposits at South Korea’s five major banks to a historic high of roughly $77 billion.

Although market expectations for a Fed rate hike in September have risen to between 57% and 60%, potentially weighing on the won, sustained foreign demand for South Korean assets continues to underpin the currency strongly.

Analysts caution that the appreciation pace may face challenges ahead. BNY Mellon senior strategist Geoffrey Yu noted that as the won’s rally tightens, domestic asset managers might unwind some overseas hedges and retail investors could resume overseas stock investments.

items.title: 日元行情正在好轉 兌歐元、英鎊與瑞郎率先走強
items.title_en: Yen Moves Higher, Leading Gains Against Euro, Pound and Franc
paras: 外匯交易員對日元的看法日益樂觀，這項轉變率先反映在主要交叉匯率。日元近期兌歐元、瑞士法郎及英鎊走強，相關漲勢可能進一步延伸至美元，帶動美元兌日元匯率續跌。
日本當局實際干預與口頭干預接連出現，加上市場對日本央行升息的預期升溫，正逐步改善日元的整體環境。另一方面，日本政府退休金投資基金（GPIF）可能將更多海外資金匯回國內、轉進日本債券，也成為支撐日元的潛在因素。
值得注意的是，在美元兌日元上周跌至155關卡前夕，投機交易員一度增加日元淨空頭部位，但這些部位可能已經大幅削減。由於歐元及瑞郎淨空頭部位仍處低檔，也讓交易員在日本央行公布利率決策前，仍有充足空間透過交叉匯率建立日元多頭部位。
隨著市場對日本央行轉向鷹派的預期升高，投資人將關注9月18日的利率決策是否以9比0全票通過升息，以及行長植田和男會後是否保留10月再次升息的可能性。
此外，隨著日元逼近155關口，空頭踩踏風險急劇升溫。摩根大通策略師田中俊雅等人警告，若美元兌日元貶破155，龐大的空頭部位恐被逼加速解除，引發連鎖賣盤。
根據摩根大通估計，目前仍有約16至17兆日元的看空部位尚未平倉，若完全解除，理論上可能將匯價推入142至146區間，但其基準判斷仍是美元兌日元處於155至165區間。
另一重大不確定性來自日本官方。最高外匯事務官員三村淳表示，對近期日元走勢「既不滿意，也沒有感到安心」，日本仍處「高度警戒狀態」，被解讀為可能繼續干預的訊號。
分析人士認為，9月18日BOJ會議後恰逢「白銀周」假期，流動性下降，不排除當局利用此時段行動。
paras_en: Forex traders are becoming increasingly optimistic about the yen, a shift first reflected in the major cross‑rates. The yen has recently strengthened against the euro, Swiss franc and pound, and the rally could extend to the dollar, pushing the USD/JPY rate lower further.

Actual and verbal interventions by Japanese authorities have appeared in succession, and rising market expectations of a Bank of Japan rate hike are gradually improving the yen’s overall environment. Meanwhile, the Government Pension Investment Fund may repatriate more overseas assets into domestic Japanese bonds, providing another potential support for the yen.

It is noteworthy that, just before the dollar‑yen slipped to the 155 level last week, speculative traders briefly increased net short positions in the yen, but those positions have likely been cut sharply. Because net short positions on the euro and franc remain low, traders still have ample room to build yen long positions via cross‑rates before the BOJ announces its rate decision.

With market expectations rising that the BOJ will turn hawkish, investors will watch whether the September 18 rate decision is approved unanimously 9‑0 and whether Governor Kazuo Ueda will keep the option of another hike in October after the meeting.

Furthermore, as the yen approaches the 155 threshold, the risk of a short‑covering squeeze is heating up. JPMorgan strategists such as Toshimasa Tanaka warned that if USD/JPY falls below 155, the massive short side could be forced to unwind rapidly, triggering a cascade of sell orders.

JPMorgan estimates that about ¥16‑17 trillion of short positions remain open; if fully unwound, the yen could theoretically be pushed into the 142‑146 range, although its baseline view still places USD/JPY in the 155‑165 band.

A further major uncertainty comes from Japanese officials. Senior foreign‑exchange official Jun Mimura said he is “neither satisfied nor reassured” by the recent yen moves and that Japan remains in a “high‑alert state,” a comment read as a possible signal of continued intervention.
Analysts note that the BOJ meeting on September 18 falls during the “Silver Week” holiday, when liquidity drops, and it cannot be ruled out that authorities might act during that window.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】美國就業數據強，一度激勵美元
items.title_en: [Far East Commercial Bank] Strong US Employment Data Briefly Boosted the Dollar
paras: ◆USD/JPY

上周美國當周初請失業金人數增加，可是裁員人數仍處低位，而且供應管理協會(ISM)調查美國8月服務業投入價格指數躍升至三年高位，但美國7月貿易逆差擴大，並據美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)理事沃勒稱，若通貨膨脹降溫，主張本月維持利率不變，而且美國副總統萬斯認為通貨膨脹數據足以支持FED降息，市場削減對FED本月加息的押注，上週五壓抑美元；此外，日本財務省公布7月日本家庭支出較上年同期降3.6%，為連續八個月下滑，更創兩年半最大跌幅，但不太可能影響日本央行(BOJ)決策，而且日本財務官三村淳仍警惕匯率走勢，重申東京已做好準備必要時干預外匯市場，打壓美元兌日圓至155.27低點。

隨後美國勞工部數據顯示，8月非農業就業崗位增加16.2萬個，接近預期5.6萬個的三倍，失業率則持穩於4.1%及勞動參與率從7月的61.4%回升至61.6%，增強市場對FED最快可能本月加息的押注，芝加哥商業交易所(CME)的FedWatch的工具則顯示，金融市場預計FED在9月15-16日會議上調政策利率的機率升至約65%，而且克利夫蘭聯邦儲備銀行總裁哈瑪克稱當前利率不足以抑制過高的通貨膨脹，再次重申支持加息，推升美元兌日圓至156.74高點價位。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於156.00-20，支撐於154.30-50。
◆EUR/USD

上周市場押注BOJ加息激勵日圓大漲，引發日圓相關利差交易軋空，而且紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)升息後預示緊縮路徑遠比預期溫和且有限，降低10月再加息的臆測，令紐元承壓，但上週五RBNZ貨幣政策委員會委員漢森表示該行本月升息是明確的一致性決定，決策者認為當前貨幣政策環境具刺激性，而且澳洲經濟增長和通貨膨脹數據提高澳洲央行(RBA)本月29日會議再加息的機率達66%，推升澳幣，帶動歐元兌美元觸及1.1633高點。

隨後德國統計局公布7月工業訂單經季節與日曆調整較前月增長2.5%遠超過預期，並據標準普爾(S&P)調查8月建築業採購經理指數(PMI)，德國升至48.7，但歐元區、法國和義大利分別降至43.0、37.3及41.7，而且歐元區7月零售銷售意外較前月降0.6%及較去年年同期增加0.6%遜於預期，在美國發布強勁的就業報告激勵美元後，推低歐元兌美元匯價至1.1583低點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於1.1580-1.1600，阻力於1.1660-80。
◆GBP/USD
